name: Brian Shaw
why: His own senior class studio portrait; the only other frame of him is the back row of a 39-person ASG group photograph.
caption_quote: BRIAN SHAW, civil engin. tech., Henderson

src.label: 1983 Talisman, p. 351, senior portraits (Sha-Smi). The names run in blocks of five down the right-hand column and each block is one row of five portraits, left to right; Shaw is third of five in the first block and third in the top row. The rows line up: positions 1, 4 and 5 are the women Cynthia A. Shaver, Carol A. Sheets and Deborah N. Shelton, positions 2 and 3 the men Richard K. Shaver and Shaw. The volume's index reads "Shaw, Brian Douglas 232, 233, 258, 351", and p. 232 is the Associated Student Government group photograph whose back row names Brian Shaw, so the face on 351 is the ASG parliamentarian and not a namesake.

name: Gil Cowles
why: His own junior class studio portrait; the only alternatives are a 39-person ASG group shot and two club group shots.

src.label: 1983 Talisman, p. 309, junior portraits (Cle-Eva). The names run in blocks of six down the right-hand column, one block per row of six portraits, left to right; Cowles is fifth of six in the third block and fifth in the third row. The rows check out by sex: that row is Sarah J. Coomes, John W. Cornelius, Lisa Cossey, Malia Coursey, Cowles, Teresa K. Cowles, and positions 2 and 5 are the only men in it. The index reads "Cowles, Gil Ray 206, 212, 232, 309", and p. 232 is the Associated Student Government group photograph whose third row names Gil Cowles, so the portrait is the ASG delegate.

name: Quinton Fawbush
why: His own freshman class studio portrait, cut two years before his Congress term; the only other frame of him is the back row of a 22-man fraternity group.

src.label: 1983 Talisman, p. 269, freshman portraits (Eze-Gil). The names run in blocks of six down the right-hand column, one block per row of six portraits, left to right; Fawbush is second of six in the first block and second in the top row. The row checks out by sex: positions 2 and 3 are the only men in it, matching Fawbush and Louis Ferguson, while 1, 4, 5 and 6 are Kimberly L. Ezell, Sherry M. Fielder, Ronda Finley and Lisa Fisher. He is the only Fawbush in the volume, indexed once as "Fawbush, Quintin Louis 251" for the Lambda Chi Alpha group photograph. The Talisman spells him Quintin; the archive follows the SGA record's Quinton.

name: Jon Norris
why: His own freshman class studio portrait, the only individual frame of him the archive holds.

src.label: 1983 Talisman, p. 276, freshman portraits (Mor-Pow). The names run in blocks of six down the left-hand column, one block per row of six portraits, left to right; Norris is second of six in the fifth block and second in the fifth row. That row is the only one on the page with a single man in it, and he stands in position 2, against Lisa Norman, Linda Nowlin, Anita Oakes, Kimberly L. Odear and Katherine L. Ogden. He is the only Jonathan Norris in the volume's index, "Norris, Jonathan Paul 276", and the Herald index for 14 October 1982 carries "Doug Robertson, Jon Norris Win Election", which puts a Jon Norris in Associated Student Government in the same academic year this portrait was taken.

name: Kevin Hargrave
why: His own senior class studio portrait, the only individual frame of him in the archive; the alternatives are two small club group shots.

src.label: 1990 Talisman, p. 83, senior portraits (Goa-Har). The names run in blocks of five down the right-hand column, one block per row of five portraits, left to right; Hargrave is last of five in the third block and last in the third row. The row checks out by sex: Charles F. Hale, Jennifer Halsey, Melissa Hamby, Keith Hampton, Hargrave, giving man, woman, woman, man, man, which is exactly what the row shows. name: Dan Townsend
why: His own senior class studio portrait from the first of his two Congress years; no other frame of him exists in the archive.

name: Deven Delano
why: His own class studio portrait, cut from the volume printed the year before his term; the 1991 volume's copy of him is a much coarser scan.

src.label: 1990 Talisman, p. 111, underclassmen portraits (Cha-Eas). The names run in blocks of six down the right-hand column, one block per row of six portraits, left to right; Delano is fifth of six in the sixth block and fifth in the sixth row. The row checks out by sex: Herbert Davis, Laurie Davis, Bill Dawson, Beth Decker, Delano, Sandra DeVasher gives man, woman, man, woman, man, woman, and that is exactly the alternation the row shows. The index reads "Delano, Devin - 111"; the 1991 volume repeats him at p. 107 and the SGA scrapbook UA12/2/16 names Devin Delano, and he is listed a sophomore here, which makes him a junior in the year the archive records him as a junior class officer.

name: Robin Kinman
why: Her senior class studio portrait, taken two years after her term as secretary; the only individual frame of her, and the alternative is a fifteen-person ASG group.

src.label: 1991 Talisman, p. 95, senior portraits (Kel-Lin). The names run in blocks of four down the right-hand column, one block per row of four portraits, left to right; Kinman opens the second block and is first in the second row. The row checks out by sex: Kinman, Kevin K. Knepp, Keith J. Krampe, Rhonda S. Kugler, and the row shows woman, man, man, woman. She is the only Robin Kinman in the 1988, 1990 and 1991 volumes; the 1988 Talisman, p. 172, prints her in the front row of the Associated Student Government group photograph, and the Herald index carries her piece "Building Associated Student Government" on 29 March 1988.
